sub_questions: Which of the paper's findings N1-N9 are genuinely new versus already owned by prior work, judged from fetched-and-grepped primary literature?
For each claim N1-N9, what is the verdict: PRIOR WORK FOUND (citation + specific overlapping sentence), NONE FOUND (exact queries run), or NOT VERIFIABLE?

N1: Is the confound-taxonomy SHAPE ('name the confounds, give the protocol that removes them, show the ranking changes') already owned by reality-check literature (Ferrari Dacrema RecSys 2019, Balduzzi NeurIPS 2018, Henderson AAAI 2018, Musgrave ECCV 2020, Lucic NeurIPS 2018, Agarwal NeurIPS 2021)? What is the residual specific to offline MBO?
N2: Does any prior work report K-dependence of a surrogate-class RANKING (not merely ensemble accuracy) in BO or offline MBO? Nearest is Abe et al. NeurIPS 2022.

N3: Is 'a shared beta across surrogate classes with different sigma scales delivers unmatched effective conservatism' named anywhere in BO, offline RL, or offline MBO pessimism/conservatism literature?

N4: Is the hypothesis 'the GP wins because its posterior variance grows away from data, making LCB an implicit trust region' already owned (SNGP Liu 2020, DUE van Amersfoort, TuRBO Eriksson, deep-ensembles-confidently-wrong)? Prepare for both beta=0 control outcomes.

N5: Does NTK / spectral-bias / DNN-as-GP literature (Jacot 2018, Rahaman 2019, Lee 2018, Li/Rudner/Wilson ICLR 2024) support the adversarial reading that a jagged ensemble posterior mean is a finite-width/under-training artifact rather than a surrogate-class property?

N6: Does ANY prior work run a crossed surrogate x optimizer factorial in offline MBO (one counterexample is fatal)? How much do Li/Rudner/Wilson ICLR 2024, Tan ICLR 2025, Chemingui AAAI 2024, Trabucco Design-Bench, Kim 2025 survey already own?

N7: Has anyone manipulated surrogate smoothness in BOTH directions (smooth the net, roughen the GP) to identify smoothness as the causal axis of a surrogate-class gap? Forward-cite IGNITE NeurIPS 2024 and MS-DDEO SWEVO 2022 into 2025-2026.

N8: Is 'platform or library version moves benchmark results by the same order as the method differences under study' documented in ML reproducibility / numerical-determinism / RNG-portability literature (Gundersen & Kjensmo AAAI 2018)?
N9: Is there precedent for a reality-check / reproducibility paper whose audit STRENGTHENS (rather than shrinks) the audited finding?

For each candidate paper A (repaired measurement), C (mechanism), D (confound taxonomy): what is the ONE SENTENCE a reviewer could not get from any prior paper, or a statement that no such sentence exists?
What are the three strongest citations that could REJECT this paper, and what would each say?
AAAI-27 venue fit: from the fetched areas-and-topics page, which primary topic best fits each of A/C/D, and what reviewer pool does each summon?
